_README: Copy to ~/.body-double/private/terms.json and chmod 600, or just run `bodydouble add`,
which is safer because it reads input hidden so a term never lands on screen or in
This file is an EXAMPLE. Every value below is fictional. Your real list is a
directory of exactly the names you are protecting, so treat it like a password file:
mode 600, outside any repo, never synced anywhere you would not sync credentials.

path_overrides.why: this tree is full of numeric data that trips the account-number rule, and hiding numbers you need to read is worse than showing them

terms._hint: list the full name AND the short forms; longest match wins, so both are safe
distinct labels per child keep sentences readable: 'child one has the allergy, child two does not' still means something, where two identical 'child' tokens do not
schools, daycares and pediatric practices are the identifiers people forget until after the upload
a practice name specific enough to identify a person's situation

_NOT_RECOMMENDED: Do not add generic relation words like 'wife', 'son' or 'daughter'. They identify
nobody, and they will rewrite unrelated text: any document mentioning someone
else's son becomes 'child'. Redact names, not roles.
Do not add your own name if you appear on camera under it anyway. Your OS username
is the one worth redacting, since it sits inside every absolute path on screen.
